content.text: Search Reddit r/ClaudeAI for posts from the last 3 months about: Claude Code skills, hooks, MCPs, productivity tools, automation. List the top 10-15 most upvoted or interesting posts with titles, brief description of what they share, and any GitHub links mentioned. Focus on posts that share NEW tools, skills, hooks, or workflows that developers would find useful. Exclude posts that are just questions or complaints.
